# Preface {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note}
## Living document — work in progress
This is the open, ongoing research record of **territorial AI safety**. It is published continuously: the version you are reading reflects the latest commit, and sections will be incomplete, revised, or wrong. That is by design — the work is meant to be built and argued with in the open.

**Status:** v0.x · See the roadmap in the [Dialogoo white paper](https://github.com/dialogoo/dialogoo-whitepaper).
:::

## What this book is

A place is more or less resilient to the erosion of human agency depending on its structure: how distributed its decision-making is, how redundant its communication channels are, how dense its civic life is, how exposed it is to capture by a single mediating layer. This book defines that idea, turns it into a transparent and reproducible **evaluation index**, and maps the result.

It is one project under the [Dialogoo](https://github.com/dialogoo) umbrella, and the source of the materials produced by Dialogoo's *Communicate* pillar.

## How it is organized

- **Foundations** — why agency erosion is the central risk, and why it is territorial.
- **The framework** — what territorial AI safety is, and the pillars and indicators that operationalize it.
- **Methodology** — how the index is built, tested for robustness, and matured from sketch to instrument.
- **Application** — the pilot, the map, and the materials for community leaders.

Methodology chapters contain live code: the numbers in the book are produced by the same pipeline described in the text (see @sec-constructing).

## How to read the living version

The HTML site rebuilds on every push. To run it yourself, see the [README](https://github.com/dialogoo/territorial-ai-safety) — `quarto preview` serves a live-reloading copy locally.

## How to contribute

The most useful contribution is an attack on the framework: tell us where an indicator fails to measure what it claims to. Open an issue, suggest a source, or propose a territory for the pilot.
